result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and signalized pedestrian crossings, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to traffic during the crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to potential vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or refuge island to protect pedestrians who may not finish crossing in one signal cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides, but the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance for pedestrians. The environment is dominated by multi-lane vehicle traffic with no median refuge or curb extensions to reduce exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a midpoint refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or island to protect pedestrians who may not be able to cross the entire width in one signal cycle.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide two-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk that is significantly faded and worn. While a sidewalk is present on the right side, the environment lacks active traffic control, pedestrian signals, or physical protection like refuge islands, creating a high-exposure crossing for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The high-visibility crosswalk paint is significantly degraded, reducing its effectiveness in alerting drivers to the crossing zone.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs, traffic signals, or pedestrian-activated beacons to manage vehicle-pedestrian interactions at this wide crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and trees on the left side of the image may obstruct sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Crosswalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repaint the continental crosswalk markings with high-durability materials to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install R1-6 'Yield to Pedestrians' in-street signs or roadside warning signs to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines by preventing parking too close to the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image depicts a multi-lane commercial corridor with a high-visibility continental crosswalk but no signalization or refuge island. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of traffic control at the crossing create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic plus a shoulder/turn area without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Uncontrolled multi-lane crossing
hazards.description: The crosswalk is marked but lacks signals or stop signs to manage high-speed traffic on a wide road.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians in the crosswalk.
